End to end · still in this page

Builds

Walk through a whole build. Each sequence is one the tracks already teach. Play, pause, step, and speed work the same way as a lesson flow.

Build a RAG app over notes you may use

A retrieval build. Chunk, embed with a pinned model, retrieve, rerank, and cite an openable span or refuse.

Build an MCP server a host can refuse

An MCP build. Host, client, and server. Tools, resources, and prompts. Stdio locally, streamable HTTP remotely, with consent.

Build an eval harness with a gate

An eval harness. Versioned tasks, four numbers, a baseline, and a gate a person owns.

Build an agent with tools and a stop

An agent build. A goal, an allowlist, a schema, a handler, a stop, and a trace.

Set up a local model

A local setup. Localhost, a size that fits, a license you read, and folders that stay apart.

Write a prompt with a done-check

A prompt build. Job, input, done-check, refusal, and one change at a time.

Budget one context window

A context budget. One window, four spenders, that model's tokenizer, and room for the answer.

Compare keyword and vector retrieval

Hybrid retrieval. Keywords for exact strings, vectors for paraphrase, then a rerank of what you actually fetched.

Cite a span or refuse

Citations. An id, an openable span, and a refusal when the notes do not contain the answer.

Review a coding-agent diff

A coding-agent review. The diff, the test command, and a person who owns the merge.

Decide whether to train a LoRA

A LoRA decision. Prompt, schema, retrieval, and tools first. Train only the gap those did not close.

Fit QLoRA without confusing it with quantization

QLoRA. A quantized frozen base plus a trained adapter. Say which one you did.

Choose a quantization and measure it

Quantization. A storage choice. Measure two prompts. Do not call it fine-tuning.

Write a one-page safety policy

A one-page policy. Data, tools, human actions, and what is out of scope.

Put a person on send, pay, and delete

Approval. Draft, show the exact arguments, then a person, then the handler.

Specify a feature a builder can measure

A product spec. Person, job, constraint, four numbers, and a kill switch.

Finish the capstone assistant

The capstone. Allowed notes, tests first, citations, one read-only tool, and a gate that allows not yet.

See what sampling does and does not do

Sampling. Temperature and top-p reshape a distribution. They do not add facts.

Validate a tool schema in your code

A tool schema. Your parser decides. The model may propose. It may not guess.

Treat tool text as untrusted

A guardrail build. Untrusted text stays data. The job stays in your channel. The fixture is in the eval.

Hand work to a second agent only with a file

A handoff. One artifact, two allowlists, two traces. A shared chat is not a design.

Read a bill without inventing a price

A cost reading. Input, output, cache, tools, and retries. Prices come from your own card.
